meta.title: A demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
meta.problem_it_fixes: The ten static gates decide whether a strategy may go live. Nothing decided what happens after it is live. A promotion-only system is a ratchet: one lucky validation keeps a strategy funded forever.

promotion_gate.tier_2: 8-9 of 10 with the executable gate verified - paper trade

meta.asymmetry: Promotion is slow (ten gates on a large sample). Demotion is fast (a single rule breach). That asymmetry is deliberate.

rules.name: Signal decay
rules.trigger: The live strategy's lower 95% ROI bound falls to 0 or below over its last 200 settled bets.

rules.name: Drawdown against the validated curve
rules.trigger: Cumulative profit falls more than 2 standard deviations below the validated backtest path.

rules.name: Market move against the origin
rules.trigger: The closing line no longer differs from the fair line in the direction the signal claims, for 3 consecutive weeks.

rules.name: Price availability
rules.trigger: The price taken is worse than the validated price by more than the modelled edge for 10 consecutive bets.

rules.name: Data integrity
rules.trigger: Any input hash changes without a recorded re-validation, or the official results feed disagrees with the committed data for a week in the live window.

rules.name: Gate re-test
rules.trigger: The strategy fails any of the ten static gates when re-tested on new data.

rules.name: Replacement-depth shock
rules.trigger: A team the strategy depends on loses a first-string player at a position the strategy's edge is built on, and depth is 3rd string or worse.

rules.name: Silence
rules.trigger: No settled bet for 21 days during the live window.

transitions.requires: all ten static gates pass AND D1-D6 have an evaluable history
any of D1, D2, D3, D4, D6 fires
the input hash is restored or the official results are reconciled
the full ten-gate validation is re-run on fresh data and passes

state_machine.no_route: There is no transition from paper (demoted) straight back to live on the old evidence. A demoted strategy must re-earn its place on data it has not seen.

current_state.note: Nothing is live, so no demotion has fired. The gate is published pre-armed so that the first live strategy has a defined exit before it has a defined entry.

evaluability.note: Needs 200 settled live bets; computable as soon as a strategy is live.
Needs a validated backtest path; none exists because no strategy passed.
Needs an opening price snapshot; only one season of opening lines exists (SD-01).
Needs verified executable prices; the executable gate has never been verified.
The manifest already hashes every input.
The ten static gates already run.
